answerRule: For each card copy, main_set is its card_set value; print_class and sub_set come only from that copy’s numeric edition. Numeric edition never supplies or overrides the main set.

fields.card_set: Main set of a particular copy; copies sharing a card_detail_id can have different values.
fields.edition: Numeric print identity on a card copy. It is not always the main set.
fields.editions: Comma-separated numeric print identities in a card definition. The definition has no card_set.
fields.main_set: Copy card_set value as-is, or null when absent.
fields.main_set_label: Human label for a known card_set value, otherwise null.
fields.print_class: Classification of the copy numeric edition, or null when unmapped.
fields.sub_set: Named subordinate print group for this numeric edition, or null.
fields.edition_unmapped: True when the numeric edition is absent from this table.

numericEditions.label: Promo
numericEditions.note: Mixed legacy promo and reward print class; it does not name one main set.

numericEditions.label: Reward
numericEditions.note: Seen inside Beta and Chaos main sets; it does not name one main set.

numericEditions.label: Gladius
numericEditions.note: The observed gladius card_set was not matched to numeric edition 6 on an owned copy.

numericEditions.label: Nightmare
numericEditions.note: The observed other value covers a family, without a copy-level match to edition 9.

numericEditions.label: Soulkeep Promo
numericEditions.note: The observed other value covers a family, without a copy-level match to edition 11.

numericEditions.label: Foundations
numericEditions.note: The observed foundations card_set was not matched to numeric edition 15 on an owned copy.

numericEditions.label: Extra
numericEditions.note: Cross-cutting print class; it does not name one main set. Cross-cutting Extra class; no single main set.

numericEditions.label: Verico (Visions of Verico)
numericEditions.note: Label supplied from the public website mapping; no copy was seen in the account sample. Verico was not observed in the account sample; no copy-level main-set mapping was established.

cardSetValues.label: Alpha
cardSetValues.relationship: Main set shown on observed copies; shared IDs 1–59 can also have Beta copies.

cardSetValues.label: Beta
cardSetValues.relationship: Main set shown on observed copies, including some with numeric Reward edition 3. Shared IDs 1–59 can also have Alpha copies.

cardSetValues.label: Untamed
cardSetValues.relationship: Observed main set; number 4 has the matching set label, but do not replace the copy's card_set with a definition's editions.

cardSetValues.label: Chaos Legion
cardSetValues.relationship: Observed main set; numeric Reward edition 3 also appeared on a Chaos card.

cardSetValues.label: Rebellion
cardSetValues.relationship: Observed main set; number 12 has the matching set label.

cardSetValues.label: Conclave Arcana
cardSetValues.relationship: Observed main set; number 14 has the matching set label.

cardSetValues.label: Foundations
cardSetValues.relationship: Observed card_set, but no owner-based numeric-edition match was established; names 15 and 16 suggest a relationship only.

cardSetValues.label: Gladius
cardSetValues.relationship: Observed card_set, but no owner-based numeric-edition match was established; name 6 suggests a relationship only.

cardSetValues.label: Land
cardSetValues.relationship: Observed main set; number 19 has the matching set label.

cardSetValues.label: Other (Nightmare/Soulkeep family)
cardSetValues.relationship: Observed value covers the Nightmare/Soulkeep family. The sample did not map each copy to numeric editions 9 or 11; other is not a precise set name.

sharedAlphaBeta: Card-detail IDs 1–59 appeared with both alpha and beta across copies. Use the particular copy's card_set, not its shared ID.
uidPrefixWarning: A C1-, C2- or C3- card UID prefix is not a set. Observed C3-82 was Beta-era and C3-337 was Chaos.

measurement.limits: Verico/Visions of Verico was not seen. Foundations and Gladius were seen without an owner-based numeric-edition match. Some definition IDs, including 205, were not owned by sampled accounts.

sources: Splinterlands public website bundle numeric edition labels; mapping supplied for this review, not independently fetched here
